messages:
miguel: quick sync / flag: console will expose per-route RBAC enforcement. need to align on router semantics, telemetry, and rollout.

sarah: ops request: global emergency kill-switch for enforcement. also per-tenant opt-out for support.

rohit: engineering: two behaviors from entitlements API: mode=hard (router blocks) or mode=annotate (router tags, runtime enforces). hard requires cache + invalidation pubsub.

anya: product: enterprise customers expect hard by default. self-serve starts annotate. want preflight simulation in console before flipping.

kai: UI: show a small badge on route list for enforcement state and a hover with last preflight result. reuse quota badge styling.

sam: telemetry plan: counters only (rbac.allow / rbac.deny / rbac.fallback:model) with tags route_id + tenant_tier. full scope lists go to auditstore only.

elaine: audit policy: keep full matched scopes in encrypted auditstore, default 90d retention, include kms_key metadata. strip tenant PII on exports.

miguel: entitlements sketch:
POST /v1/entitlements/eval -> {mode, decision, matched[], ttl}
mode controls enforcement; decision is check outcome.

rohit: rollout: per-tenant deterministic pct (hash(tenant_id) < pct). also send invalidation messages on role changes.

anya: preflight modal idea: admin supplies sample principal -> shows decision, matched scopes, and simulated routing outcome (model vs fallback) plus short why for denies.

ops-bot: deploy queued: branch=rbac-enforce, env=staging, pr=4782 :white_check_mark:

rohit: edge-case: wildcard scopes. entitlements should return normalized matched keys; router should use predicate eval not naive string matching. matched array saved only to audit logs.

miguel: action items: rohit+sam API spec (ETA: EOD), kai+sam preflight mocks (ETA: Wed), elaine+sarah telemetry & retention policy (ETA: Fri), miguel drafts rollout SOP. i'll post doc link when ready.

sarah: noted. i'll add changelog blurb about hard-mode semantics.

kai: will prototype badge and ping for review. :rocket:
